posts.title: A PostgreSQL Hot Update study on small tables. Fillfactor and Hash Partitioning Strategies.
posts.description: Can reserving more space for updates make a small, frequently updated PostgreSQL table faster? I compared the default schema, a lower fillfactor, and hash partitioning on a table of approximately 500 MB.
